title: Chapter 405
paragraphs: Chapter 405
Episode 119: Banquet at the Imperial Palace (10)
Kiiiing-!
The sphere of magical energy in his hand spun, emitting a sharp noise. The gray-robed figures instantly recognized the magic and hastily raised their protective shields.
Under the dark night sky, the sphere of the Reverse Heaven shone like the moon.
Lightning struck around the sphere. The bolts of lightning relentlessly struck the gray-robed figures' protective shields.
Under normal circumstances, the power of the Myungwang Sword's lightning strike would not have been enough to penetrate the gray-robed figures' shields. They were also exceptional magicians.
However, the problem was the power of the Reverse Heaven.
The protective shield, which needed to be maintained tightly, seemed to be on the verge of collapsing as it shook.
Moreover, the lightning was not meant to break through the shield, but to disrupt their vision.
Pazzez, pajit!
The scattered lightning blinded the gray-robed figures. As a result, they could not easily track Jin's movements.
[Kaaaak!]
The living golems charged at Jin. They each had considerable strength, but it was meaningless if they couldn't touch him.
As the pressure from the lightning converted, the charging living golems lost their balance and hesitated.
Jin didn't miss that moment, and quickly scattered sword qi in all directions, turning them into pieces.
Superhuman close combat, and magic control that would not feel out of place even if he were called a grand magician right away. Such creatures as these crude living golems were no threat to Jin.
"Is this also Jo's work?"
Jin asked, focusing the power of Reverse Heaven towards the gray-robed figures.
Cold Jo.
Rolte Jo's brother and the head of the Dark Magic Council, he had been making a golem called "Myungin" that imitated the Myungwang Clan.
'Compared to Myungin, these are crude living golems. He must have sent these on purpose. To hide the fact that the terrorism was Kinzelo's doing.'
The gray-robed figures didn't answer and concentrated their magical power.
Jin's real curiosity lay elsewhere.
How did they create such a large number of living golems? And that for simple consumption.
There were about 300 living golems on this plain right now, and the living golems he had seen at the Imperial Palace earlier were definitely well over 10,000.
At the very least, it meant that more than 10,000 people were used as materials for the living golems.
And it was highly likely that this wasn't even the whole picture.
'Someone is helping Kinzelo supply human resources.'
It was a difficult number for Kinzelo to supply on their own. It meant that there were sponsors from at least an upper-ranked empire or kingdom.
Even during the days when the Dark Magic Council's headquarters were in Oterium, Kinzelo barely managed to gather thousands of people using the Holy Kingdom.
'If possible, I'd like to capture them alive and find out, but they won't be sloppy enough to pass on information during torture. They must have a means of suicide.'
Squeak!
Before he knew it, Jin had broken through the grey-robed mages' barrier and struck with Sigmund.
The grey-robed mages couldn't detect the moment Jin attacked because their vision was obscured by the lightning.
Although the blade was deflected, the barrier also shattered. Fragments scattered, and Jin, regaining his posture, thrust Sigmund into the fray.

The familiar sensation of flesh and bone catching on the blade's tip was transmitted. Jin had stabbed the shoulder of the mage at the front, while behind him, other mages were casting offensive spells.
There were two beams of magical power and an ice blade.
Jin dodged the magical beams and blocked the ice blade with his own sword. Shattered ice fragments scratched Jin's cheek, drawing blood.
However, at that moment, the grey-robed mage with the stabbed shoulder met his end. The blade that had deflected the ice blade had cut through his entire body.
'Three left.'
When the dead grey-robed mage fell, his hood came off.
Although Jin had never seen a mage of this caliber before, it was the first time he had seen such a face.
It was unclear whether Bubare had disguised him or if he was a mage who had been active in the shadows.
The sphere of counterflow was spinning faster and faster. The mage who had unleashed the ice blade doubled over, coughing up blood, while the remaining two mages re-established their barrier.
The counterflow reaction was coming.

Jin felt confident that he could end the fight with ease. While it was true that the grey-robed mages were exceptional, like most people in the world, they were not accustomed to fighting against a sword mage.
Even elite warriors would find it impossible to control the distance against Jin in close combat.

Moreover, the mages couldn't do much against Jin. They might have been able to maintain their distance with other spells if it weren't for the counterflow, but they couldn't find the opportunity to cast anything other than the barrier.
The flesh golems continued to try to restrain Jin, but they were swept away like fallen leaves whenever they managed to get close.
"Kuh, kuh!"
The remaining two grey-robed mages were also caught in the counterflow. Even Jin's combat power would be drastically reduced once the counterflow began, let alone the mages.
"Why do you look so panicked? Did you not know this would happen when you attacked the Imperial Palace? I thought you were prepared to die."
The reason why the Imperial Palace fell into chaos was because their attack was a 'terrorist act.'
The grey-robed mages, the giant magical beasts, and the flesh golems were not weak. They could have dealt a devastating blow to a small- or medium-sized country with their forces alone.
However, facing the Imperial Palace, especially with Ron Hairan present, was an impossible task.
If they had attacked head-on instead of resorting to terrorism, they would have been swept away by Ron's sword or Hairan's knights before they could even reach the palace.
Even without the backing of the Vermont family, the Hairan family was one of the most powerful families in the world.
With a slash, Sigmund cut off another grey-robed mage's right arm. The blade had been deflected by the barrier, but the fact that he would soon die remained unchanged.
While Jin was becoming more and more at ease, the mages were endlessly driven into a corner.
Even the power of the counterflow was now at its peak.
Wrinkles began to appear on the hands of the mages exposed between the gray robes.
It was a common phenomenon when forcibly resisting the counterflow, and in that state, one's body would soon shrivel up and blood would pour from every orifice.
The escorts of Veradin at the back had pale faces as they watched Jin fight.
The idea of competing against such a person as their lord seemed somehow distant to them.
Although it seemed that there was some sort of friendship between the lord and Jin, the two were ultimately from Runcandel and Zipfel.
At this point, it wouldn't be strange if Jin finished off the mages and suddenly changed his mind, turning his sword on the lord.
Rather, according to the escorts' common sense, it would have been more advantageous for Jin to kill Veradin and them in several ways.
Although Jin had received Ron's special order to save Veradin, Jin was still from Runcandel.

There was no need for him to carry out Ron's special order, and there wouldn't be a second chance in his life to kill the successor of Zipfel without any witnesses, especially with a scapegoat available.
In reality, if it were another Runcandel, there would be no one to spare Veradin.
As if reading their thoughts, Veradin made eye contact with the escorts.
"Jin is not like that, rest assured and wait."
Crackle-!
Now, every time lightning struck, the gray-robed mages screamed.
Even when the shock was transferred through the protective barrier, they seemed unable to endure it any longer.
There was no need to use the sword technique of the Underworld King or the Spirit Weapon, as they were driving the gray-robed mages to death with just ordinary attacks and magic.
Their breathing was rough, as if they were about to collapse at any moment.
Jin looked at their tattered protective barrier with cold eyes.
It was time to end it.
However, the moment he took a step to cut off the gray robes' breath.
Jin suddenly looked back.
He felt a powerful and familiar energy spreading from behind him for no apparent reason.
Whirring...!
The area was momentarily illuminated by a dark light.
The scene he saw as he turned around was the Imperial Sword Castle.

Thousands of lightning bolts were striking there. It wasn't comparable to the tide of lightning Jin had caused in Runcandel, but it was a scale that couldn't be explained by a 10-star lightning magic he knew.
More importantly, it wasn't magic that made up the lightning.
'The power of the brothers...!?'
The power of the strongest battle race in history, the Underworld King race.
The lightning that was battering the Imperial Sword Castle clearly resembled that power.
Although subtly different, it was an energy so similar that even Jin could be momentarily deceived.
Underworld King.
Two characters that immediately came to Jin's mind.
'Has the Cold Emperor of the Underworld been completed? Even if it's completed, I thought they sent other failed bio-golems to hide the act of Kinzelo...!'
Chuckle, chuckle, chuckle!
Amid the sudden change in the situation and the tension in the back of his head, an unpleasant laugh reached his ears. It was the laughter that came from the mouths of the dying gray-robed mages.
"Monsters like you have always belittled what we've dedicated our lives to..."
"That's why we decided to become monsters ourselves. You, who were born as a monster, will never understand that desperate decision until you die."
The mages unraveled the gray robes that had covered their bodies and faces. When their naked bodies were revealed, Jin couldn't help but swallow a dry breath.
It was because a gem similar to the 'Luminous Heart' was embedded in their chests.
"You must have wished that this power would be yours alone, the 12th generation of Runcandel."
"A new world will open, and there will be no place for you in it!"
As the gem in the mages' chests emitted a radiant light, Jin clenched his teeth.
It wasn't because the 'Thunder Energy' that the mages were summoning contained an unexpected level of power.
Disgust.
The unbearable, horrible disgust he had felt when he had met the incomplete Underworld Kings in the past at Otelium.
Jin's face contorted with anger.
"Ha."
No matter how much the gems embedded in the mages' chests resembled the Luminous Heart, or how powerful the energy they contained was.
The power they possessed was ultimately stolen, and a fake that insulted the brothers themselves.
"These trash-like bastards... have crossed the line by far."
As if there was no more worth in watching, Jin charged and swung Sigmund.
Clang-!
The mages showed a physical ability of a different dimension from when they were wearing the gray robes, and blocked Sigmund with their fists.
They thought they could defeat Jin, but the next moment.
Crack!
Jin also grabbed the head of the mage in the front with his bare hands.
As he clenched his fist, the mage's head shattered, and the pieces scattered in all directions.
